prerequisites: Since the FDP is presented after having completed all other courses, the student must have, in addition to those specific to the chosen topic for the FDP, knowledge of the subjects that comprise the degree's curriculum.
To be able to enroll, the student must have passed 150 credits of the degree.

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to communicate and social aptitude.

Students should be able to apply their knowledge to their work or vocation in a professional manner and possess the competences usually demonstrated through the elaboration and defense of arguments and problem-solving within their field of study.
Students should be able to gather and interpret relevant data (normally within their field of study) to make judgments that include a reflection on relevant social, scientific, or ethical issues.
Students should be able to transmit information, ideas, problems, and solutions to both specialized and non-specialized audiences.
Students should have developed the learning skills necessary to undertake further studies with a high degree of autonomy.
Oral and written communication in the native language
Skill in the use of ICT
Capacity for critical and self-critical thinking
Ability to learn to work autonomously

Original exercise to be carried out individually and presented and defended before a university tribunal, consisting of a professional project in the field of specific technologies of Mechanical Engineering in which the competences acquired in the teachings are synthesized and integrated.

The student will be able to individually carry out, present, and defend before a tribunal, a project in the professional field of Engineering in which the competences acquired in the teachings related to this Curriculum are synthesized.

syllabus_topics: Development of the work proposed in the draft project.
Preparation of the FDP thesis document
teaching_methods: Coordination with the supervisor(s) on the drafting of the draft project.
Attendance at individual or group follow-up tutorials on the problem addressed in the FDP, the drafting of the thesis document, or its defense.
Attendance at an informative workshop on drafting the draft project.
Attendance at a workshop on drafting the FDP thesis document by the School of Engineering.
Drafting of the "Draft Project" and its electronic submission along with other FDP data.
Management of the project in which the FDP is framed.

Tasks of bibliographical consultation, documentation development, and all others required by the nature of the particular topic chosen for the FDP, thus demonstrating mastery of the specific procedures developed.
Drafting of the document(s) that comprise the thesis document.
Development of the FDP presentation for the oral exposition before the evaluating committee.

assessment_methods.method: Evaluation of the work and thesis document
Evaluation of the presentation and defense act

assessment_rules: The evaluation of the Final Degree Project will be carried out according to the UAL regulations, through an oral presentation before a tribunal formed for this purpose, after authorization of the defense by the Industrial Degree Committee. The FDP grade will be regulated according to the criteria of Art. 5.6 of the UAL's General FDP Regulations and Article 10 of the FDP regulations for Industrial Engineering Degrees of the School of Engineering. The final numerical score will consider the following indicators: Grade from the Supervisor/s: 30%; Evaluation of the work and thesis document: 40%; Evaluation of the presentation and defense act: 30%. Students must declare if they have used AI in any stage of the FDP development, indicating the tool, functions, and parts assisted by AI, following principles of good practice and transparency.
